next.localModel.title: Local model
next.localModel.lead: A model that runs on this computer: no internet and no key. Start Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp or vLLM, and it shows up here.
next.localModel.none: No server found on this computer (Ollama :11434, LM Studio :1234, llama.cpp :8080, vLLM :8000). Start one and press Refresh, or type its address below.
next.localModel.notFound: Nothing answers at {address}. Check the address and that the server is running.
next.localModel.hint: Only this computer and private networks (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x). Agent work needs a big model for code, about 30B or more (for example Qwen3-Coder); small ones lose the thread and call tools wrong. Give the model a context of at least 32k tokens: Ollama's default is smaller.
next.localModel.smallContext: The model runs with a context of {n} tokens: too small for an agent, whose instructions alone take more. Start the server with a context of 32768 or more (Ollama: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768).
